response.sql:
WITH linked AS (
    SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS acl_igm
    FROM Examination AS e
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
), centered AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm,
           acl_igm - AVG(acl_igm) OVER () AS deviation
    FROM linked
), scored AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, deviation,
           deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY SEX) AS excess
    FROM centered
)
SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm AS `aCL IgM`, deviation,
       excess AS `excess above sex average`
FROM scored
WHERE excess > 0
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Uses SQLite-style window functions and NULL ordering; the descending order places missing excess values last. Missing aCL IgM values remain in the linked population but are ignored by AVG and cannot pass the above-average filter.
